title: Lump-Sum Settlement Due-Date Extension: The Grant of Extension Days
content:
# Lump-Sum Settlement — Extension Days

**Clause.** For an extension on an accepted Lump-Sum Settlement of Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, the Lump-Sum extension days are a standard grant of 3 calendar days counted from the payment's current due date, never more than the programme's extension maximum of 10 calendar days. The extension adds those days to the settlement's extension days total and to its final payment due date, so that the payment's current due date becomes the first payment due date plus the extension days total.

The extension days are formed once, as the standard grant together with any further days that apply to the extension, the total being capped at the 10-calendar-day extension maximum only at the end; the extension days are a whole number of calendar days.

## Terms used

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Current due date | the first payment due date plus the extension days total already on the settlement |
| Extension days total | all calendar days added to the settlement by extensions |
| Final payment due date | moves later by the same days as the extension |

## Worked example on hypothetical figures

| Item | Before the extension | After an extension of 3 days |
|---|---|---|
| First payment due date | day D | day D (unchanged) |
| Extension days total | 0 | 3 |
| Current due date of the payment | day D | day D plus 3 |
| Final payment due date | day D | day D plus 3 |

## Points of judgement

- **Where is the grant counted from?** From the payment's current due date, which already reflects any extension days on the settlement.
- **Can the days granted exceed 10?** No; 10 calendar days is the extension maximum of the Lump-Sum Settlement.
- **Are part-days granted?** No; the extension days are whole calendar days.
